seo.title: Why Two Models - Dual Intelligence in BioMath Core
seo.description: BioMath Core uses two independent models — biomathematical and clinical — to analyze your health data. Learn why dual analysis improves accuracy and confidence.

hero.label: Dual intelligence
hero.title: Why two models?
hero.body: BioMath Core runs two independent analyses on your health data — one biomathematical, one clinical — and compares the results. When both agree, confidence is high. When they differ, it highlights areas worth closer attention.

models.label: Models
models.title: Two lenses on the same data
models.body: Mathematical precision and clinical expertise — each model brings a distinct strength.

items.title: Mathematical model
items.body: Pure data-driven analysis using biomathematical algorithms and statistical methods.

items.title: Clinical model
items.body: Evidence-based analysis using medical knowledge and clinical guidelines.

items.title: Higher accuracy
items.body: Cross-validation between models reduces false positives and ensures reliable insights.

items.title: Comprehensive view
items.body: See both data-driven patterns and clinical interpretations side by side.

items.title: Better decisions
items.body: Make informed choices with insights backed by both mathematics and medicine.

secondOpinion.label: Second opinion
secondOpinion.title: The second opinion advantage
secondOpinion.body: Just like seeking a second medical opinion, our dual approach provides two independent analyses of your health data. Agreement between models builds confidence. Disagreement flags areas that may need additional attention or professional consultation.
